title: Hell: Where Is It? My Problem With Its Location #shorts

top_liked.author: @gilsonsangulukaniphiri5018
top_liked.text:
Hell, just like heaven, is imaginary.
There is absolutely no evidence of its existence.

top_liked.author: @theresemalmberg955
top_liked.text: Hell is in Southeast Michigan, near the town of Pinckney.  Go up US 23 from Ann Arbor, get off at the Pinckney exit (M-36) go west to county road D-32, go south on D-32 and follow it all the way into Hell.  Can't miss it.
